Regression: API routes return proper responses instead of 404 in dev mode (#127)
checks.notes: Works because: next.config.ts now conditionally sets output: 'standalone' only for NODE_ENV=production. This prevents Next.js from prerendering API routes as static pages in dev mode, which was causing 404 responses. Routes like /api/dev-signin, /api/account/delete, /api/account/export, and /api/rollup/settings now respond with proper JSON (error messages or data) instead of HTML 404 pages.

checks.title: Regression: fix for #127

checks.notes: Works because: Created src/app/terms/page.tsx with all required sections (acceptance of terms, service description, user responsibilities, payment terms, cancellation policy, liability limitations, governing law). Page is statically generated at 3.71 kB. Signin page (/auth/signin:113) and home page footer (/page.tsx:113) now link to /terms alongside /privacy.

checks.title: Regression: fix for #125
Regression: Rollup digest scheduling respects deliverySlot and timezone (#124)
checks.notes: Works because: scheduleDailyRollup now fetches RollupSettings to get user's deliverySlot (MORNING/AFTERNOON/EVENING) and timezone preference, then calculates the correct UTC hour using getUtcHourFromLocal helper. Previously hardcoded '0 8 * * *' is now dynamically computed: MORNING=08:00, AFTERNOON=14:00, EVENING=20:00 local time converted to UTC based on user's timezone.

checks.title: Regression: fix for #124
Regression: ThemeToggle renders on sign-in page with mounted state guard (#123)
checks.notes: Works because: Added useState/useEffect mounted state guard to theme-toggle.tsx. This prevents SSR/hydration mismatch that prevented ThemeToggle from rendering. Component now returns null during SSR, preventing the 'useTheme() returned theme: undefined during SSR' issue. Build passed, theme toggle button now appears in sign-in page DOM.
